scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k 'npm run dev -w @nexus/api' 'npm run dev -w @nexus/web'
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @nexus/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
